items.title: 6.9.3 Solution ki enthalpy tabdeeli ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9.3, printed pages 133-134.

blocks.text: Solution ki, ya hydration ki, enthalpy tabdeeli enthalpy cycle bana kar aur Hess ka qanoon istemal kar ke nikali ja sakti hai. Gaseous ions ionic solid banate hain (lattice energy) aur ionic solid halta hai (enthalpy of solution); gaseous ions seedhe aqueous solution ke ions mein bhi jate hain (cation aur anion ki enthalpy of hydration). Cycle se, delta Hlatt + delta Hsol = delta Hhyd.

blocks.alt: Baen: sodium ion chaar pani ke molecules se ghira jin ke oxygen sire andar ki taraf hain, hydration aur lattice energy par notes, aur alkali halide lattice energies ka chhota schematic chart fluoride se iodide tak girta hua. Daen: dabbon ka tikon, oopar gaseous ions, neeche baen NaF solid aur neeche daen aqueous ions, lattice, hydration aur solution ke teeron aur Sample 6.8 ke adaad ke saath.
blocks.caption: Hydration, lattice energy ke rujhanat aur sodium fluoride ke liye solution ka energy cycle (Figures 6.5 se 6.7 aur Sample Problem 6.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Pani ke molecules apne delta- oxygen sire cation ki taraf (aur delta+ hydrogens anion ki taraf) rakhte hain, hydration energy kharij karte hue, jo ion ki charge density ke saath barhti hai. Gaseous ions ke solid banane par kharij lattice energy ions ke barhne se girti aur un ke charge ke saath tezi se barhti hai. Gaseous ions se aqueous ions tak do raste jate hain, to lattice energy jama enthalpy of solution hydration energy ke barabar hai; NaF ke liye (-406 - 506) - (-902) -10 kJ fi mol ka delta Hsol deta hai.

blocks.prompt: NaCl ke liye lattice energy -787 kJ fi mol aur Na+ aur Cl- ki hydration enthalpies -406 aur -364 kJ fi mol hain. Delta Hsol nikalein aur Table 6.2 se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Delta Hsol = delta Hhyd - delta Hlatt = (-406 - 364) - (-787) = -770 + 787 = in adaad se +17 kJ fi mol, table ke 4.98 kJ fi mol ki tarah endothermic; theek qeemat istemal shuda data par munhasir hai, magar nishan mutabiq hai: lattice energy hydration energy se thori zyada hai.

items: Energy cycle: delta Hlatt + delta Hsol = delta Hhyd, to delta Hsol = delta Hhyd - delta Hlatt; NaF: (-406 - 506) - (-902) = -10 kJ fi mol.
